content: Ravi Menon from Secure Future Group called Pranav Mishra to inform him that his health policy (Policy No: HP-459812) expired yesterday and he currently lacks active coverage. Pranav opted to renew the policy over the phone. Ravi verified Pranav's date of birth (12/04/1985), confirmed the monthly premium remains $120, and agreed to email a payment link to instantly reactivate the policy.

action_items: Send payment link to customer via email
Pay monthly premium of $120 to reactivate policy
